faqs.question: What services does SysInt offer?
faqs.answer: SysInt offers Enterprise Integration (Azure Integration Services, BizTalk migration, API modernization) and AI Engineering (AI Integration, Agentic Automation, Inference Platforms, Intelligent Apps). We also have an AI Agent Store for local businesses.

faqs.question: What is the AI Agent Store?
faqs.answer: The AI Agent Store provides ready-to-deploy AI chatbots for local businesses — restaurants, salons, clinics, real estate, retail, home services, legal, and education. Agents go live in 48 hours.

faqs.question: Do you help with BizTalk migration?
faqs.answer: Yes — BizTalk to Azure migration is one of our deepest capabilities. We bring 20+ years of BizTalk expertise and handle assessment, pattern preservation, and cloud-ready deployment.

faqs.question: What Azure integration services do you work with?
faqs.answer: We work with Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Event Grid, and Data Factory — the full Azure Integration Services stack.

faqs.question: How do I get an AI agent for my local business?
faqs.answer: Contact us at 440-364-6078 or gangadhar.ananthoju@sysintinc.com. We'll match the right agent to your industry and get you live within 48 hours.

faqs.question: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.answer: Local business AI agents typically go live in 48 hours — just a 20-minute setup call. Enterprise integration projects start delivering value within 2–4 weeks of kickoff.

faqs.question: What industries do you serve with AI agents?
faqs.answer: Restaurants, salons & spas, medical clinics, real estate, retail, home services, legal & professional services, and education.

faqs.question: Do local businesses need their own domain?
faqs.answer: No — a domain is optional. Without one, your site runs on yourshopname.sysintinc.com (like elite.sysintinc.com) at no extra cost. If you want a custom domain like yoursalon.com, we can set it up for an additional fee depending on availability, plus an annual renewal charge — typically $15–$50/year.

faqs.question: What does a local business AI agent actually do?
faqs.answer: It answers customer questions 24/7 (hours, pricing, services, location), handles appointment booking, captures leads after hours, sends reminders, and qualifies inquiries — all automatically, without any staff involvement.

faqs.question: Do I need any technical knowledge to use an AI agent?
faqs.answer: None at all. We handle everything — setup, hosting, customization, and ongoing support. You just share your business details and we take care of the rest.

faqs.question: Will the AI agent sound like my business?
faqs.answer: Yes. We train the agent on your specific services, prices, hours, staff, and policies so it responds in your brand's voice. It never makes up answers — if it doesn't know something, it directs customers to call you.

faqs.question: What happens after business hours?
faqs.answer: The agent stays on 24/7. It answers questions, captures lead details, and schedules appointments even when you're closed — so you never miss an inquiry again.

faqs.question: Can the AI agent book appointments?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent can connect to your existing booking system or calendar and let customers self-schedule any time of day. Automatic reminders are sent before appointments to cut no-shows by up to 60%.

faqs.question: Which local business types benefit most from an AI agent?
faqs.answer: Any business that handles repetitive customer inquiries or appointments — salons, restaurants, clinics, real estate agents, retailers, plumbers, lawyers, tutors. If your phone rings with the same questions every week, an AI agent will save you hours.

faqs.question: Is the AI agent available on my website and phone?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent can be embedded as a chat widget on your website, connected to WhatsApp, or deployed as a voice assistant for phone calls. We set up the channels that work best for your business.

faqs.question: How much does an AI agent for a local business cost?
faqs.answer: We offer three plans — Starter (website chat, FAQ, lead capture), Growth (multi-channel, CRM sync, booking integration), and Enterprise (white-label, custom workflows, multi-location). Contact us for exact pricing tailored to your business size.

faqs.question: Is there a contract or lock-in?
faqs.answer: No long-term contracts. Our plans are month to month — you can cancel any time.

faqs.question: Can I see a demo before committing?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Visit elite.sysintinc.com to see a fully working AI agent demo for a salon. You can also request a live personalized demo for your own business — we'll have it ready within 24 hours.

faqs.question: What if the AI agent gets a question it cannot answer?
faqs.answer: It politely tells the customer it doesn't have that information and directs them to call or email your business. It never guesses or makes up answers.

faqs.question: Can I update the agent's information after it goes live?
faqs.answer: Yes. Minor updates like hours, pricing, or new services are included in your monthly plan. Just contact us and we'll update the agent — usually within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Who hosts the AI agent and website?
faqs.answer: Everything runs on Microsoft Azure — secure, fast, and reliable cloud infrastructure with global availability.
